- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

home, new_flow changes consistently failed to show positive impact across 2 tests.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Pet Selection Screen: Redesign pick_friend screen using a split layout featuring live companion previews alongside interactive choice cards. (why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off (29.7%) and redesign changes in adoption have proven effective (+3.3% average).)
1: [sign_in, hint] Multi-Account Social Sign-In Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign_in screen clarifying that separate sign-in methods create independent pet profiles. (why: Support received 8 reports of missing pets caused by signing in with different social auth providers.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Confirmation Review Screen: Insert a new confirmation screen before the adoption certificate to let users review pet traits before creation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet appearance during adoption.)
3: [finish, layout] Essential Desktop Controls Checklist Layout: Change home_intro layout to a checklist format highlighting core mouse and shortcut commands for desktop interaction. (why: 3 support tickets indicated post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight Choice Path Selection Redesign: Redesign choose_path screen using a spotlight layout with structured choice cards to compare onboarding paths. (why: choose_path has a 23.2% drop-off rate and a high mean completion time of 514s, indicating path selection friction.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Preparation Quality Checklist Flow: Add a photo verification checklist and picker flow on upload_photos to guide custom pet image selection. (why: 3 support reports cited custom pet generation errors and incorrect output caused by poor input photos.)
6: [finish, hint] Desktop Tray & Account Control Hint: Add a hint to home_intro explaining how to access account settings and privacy options from the desktop tray icon. (why: Support received 4 emails after onboarding asking how to manage account settings and delete personal data.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Streamlined Story Intro Copy: Shorten story intro text to provide quick setup expectations before path selection. (why: choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, suggesting users spend unnecessary time reading long intro text.)
8: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification: Enable desktop completion notification on waiting screen to alert users when pet loading finishes. (why: 3 support emails reported pet failing to show on desktop or app appearing frozen during the initial launch wait.)
